Home.title: Find your way. Keep the journey.
Home.description: Discover GPX tracks on a map and build a collection of your own. Find a route to explore, revisit a favorite, or share a journey worth following.
Home.notice: Early in development. You can create an account; track discovery and uploads are not yet available.
Home.publicAccess: The plan: public tracks open to everyone, with no account needed to explore.
Home.mapLabel: Illustration of multiple tracks across a topographic map
Home.mapCaption: Explore by place, direction, and terrain.
Home.mapDisclosure: Illustrative map only — not a working search.

discover.eyebrow: More than a list of routes
discover.title: See where a track can take you.

place.title: Start with a place
place.description: Explore public tracks in the area you’re looking at. Show several on the map to compare where they go.

direction.title: Follow your direction
direction.description: Draw an arrow to find nearby tracks heading roughly your way, not just starting near the same point.

fit.title: Find the right fit
fit.description: Narrow your search by tags, distance, and elevation changes. Open a track to read its description and download the GPX.

how.title: From a little curiosity to your next journey.

explore.label: 01 / Explore
explore.title: Find a track
explore.description: Move around the map, refine your search, and discover tracks shared by the community.

details.label: 02 / Take a closer look
details.title: Get the details
details.description: See the route on a map, read the uploader’s notes, and download its GPX file for your own navigation tools.

own.label: 03 / Make it yours
own.title: Bring your own GPX
own.description: Create an account to upload your tracks, organize your collection, and choose what to share.

collection.title: Explore freely. Build your own atlas.
collection.description: Public discovery won’t require an account. Signing up will give your own journeys a home.
collection.notice: Account creation is available. Track uploads and collections are still in development.

keep.title: Keep your GPX collection together.
keep.description: Upload your tracks and find them again on a map.

private.title: Choose what stays private.
private.description: Keep a track just for yourself or publish it for everyone. Only public tracks can be shared.

share.title: Share something worth following.
share.description: Public tracks will appear in discovery and on your public profile.

details.title: Keep the details useful.
details.description: Update descriptions, tags, and visibility. Track geometry editing is outside the scope of Track Atlas.

openSource.title: A shared map. An open project.
openSource.description: Track Atlas is open source. Explore the code on GitHub, report a bug, suggest an idea, or help build what comes next.

Home.status: Early in development · Built in the open

Metadata.title: Track Atlas — Find your way. Keep the journey.
Metadata.description: An open-source home for GPX journeys: map-first discovery and personal track collections. Discover what’s planned for Track Atlas, currently in early development.

map.title: Recorded path map
map.privacy: Street and Outdoors use OpenFreeMap vector data without a service guarantee. Outdoors emphasizes paths, tracks, woodland, water and selected outdoor labels, without contours or shaded relief. Topographic uses volunteer-hosted OpenTopoMap raster tiles with contours and relief, with limited capacity and no service guarantee. Satellite uses Mapbox satellite imagery and is subject to Mapbox usage limits and terms. Provider requests disclose your IP address and viewed area; your GPX, track metadata and account data are not sent. Detail varies by region and zoom; mapped paths do not establish safe or permitted access.
map.satelliteFailure: Satellite imagery could not be loaded. Choose another basemap, or switch away and back to retry. The recorded track and downloads are unchanged.
map.topographicFailure: Topographic tiles could not be loaded. Choose Street or Outdoors, or switch away and back to retry. The recorded path and downloads are unchanged.

map.interaction: Use the mouse wheel or buttons to zoom, or fit the whole path. Drag to pan; on touch screens use two fingers. Tab leaves the map. The basemap is the same in light and dark themes.

Tracks.title: Upload track
Tracks.detailsUnavailable: Track details are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
Tracks.intro: Import a GPX track. Tracks are private unless you choose to publish.
Tracks.guest: Sign in using the menu or create an account to upload a track.
Tracks.unconfirmed: Confirm your email before uploading. You can resend the confirmation from account settings.
Tracks.name: Name
Tracks.descriptionHint: Required. Use 1–5,000 characters. Plain text and line breaks are preserved.
Tracks.fileHint: GPX 1.0/1.1, up to 10 MiB and 100,000 points. Exactly one track and one segment.
Tracks.activityHint: Choose one activity. This does not guarantee safety or legal access.
Tracks.difficultyHint: 1 is least difficult; 5 is most difficult for this activity. This is your assessment, not a safety rating.
Tracks.tagHint: Optional: add up to 10 tags, up to 30 characters each. Multiword tags are welcome. Enter adds a tag.
Tracks.publicWarning: Publishing lets anyone view your track, uploader identity and avatar, and download the unchanged original. The original can expose timestamps, author metadata, waypoints and other locations, even when they are not shown on the map.
Tracks.publicHint: Anyone can view this track and download its unchanged original. Keep its details URL; a track collection is not available yet.
Tracks.privateHint: Only you can view this track. Keep its details URL; a track collection is not available yet.
Tracks.invalid: Check this value and its allowed length.
Tracks.tagInvalid: Use up to 10 different tags, each no longer than 30 characters.

analytics.title: Recorded analytics
analytics.rangeHint: Elevation range is the highest recorded elevation minus the lowest, not cumulative ascent or the largest climb. With incomplete elevation, it describes only the available samples.
analytics.noElevation: No recorded elevation samples. Elevation statistics are unavailable.
analytics.partialElevation: Partial elevation coverage: {count, number} of {total, number} points. Elevation range, minimum and maximum describe only available samples; whole-track ascent and descent are unavailable.
analytics.completeElevation: Elevation is recorded at every point.
analytics.elevationHint: GPX elevation is a GPS-derived estimate and may be noisy. Ascent and descent sum raw consecutive elevation changes without smoothing and require complete elevation.
analytics.durationHint: Recorded duration includes stops and requires usable, strictly increasing timestamps at every point. It is not moving time.
analytics.speedHint: Speed is an interval average between consecutive recorded points, not instant device telemetry. Missing or non-increasing timestamps appear as chart gaps; no speed is inferred across them.
analytics.elevationChartUnavailable: Elevation chart unavailable because this recording has no elevation samples.
analytics.speedChartUnavailable: Speed chart unavailable because this recording has no usable timed intervals.
analytics.chartFailure: Charts could not be loaded. Track details and the original download are still available.
analytics.sectionUnavailable: No recorded values in this chart section. Use the section controls to inspect the rest of the recording.
analytics.keyboardHint: Focus a chart and use the left and right arrow keys to inspect recorded values. Gaps mean recorded data is unavailable. Long, fragmented charts have section controls.
analytics.downsampled: Chart display is reduced for responsiveness; extrema and data gaps are retained.
